security_verification.details: All critical security holes identified in the original problem statement are now CLOSED:
verified_protections: 1. Bypass route blocked: PUT /api/acc/purchase-requests/{id} with status='Approved'/'Submitted'/'Rejected' returns 400 with clear Indonesian message directing to proper endpoints
2. Self-approval blocked: Creator (packing@dewiaditya.id) cannot approve their own PR - returns 403 with message about 'pembuat tidak boleh menyetujui sendiri'
3. Wrong stage blocked: finance@ attempting to approve DEPT stage returns 403 with message about 'Tahap saat ini Persetujuan Departemen'
4. Double stage blocked: gudang@ who approved DEPT stage cannot approve FINANCE stage - returns 403 with message about 'sudah menyetujui' and 'dua tahap'
5. 3-person chain enforced: Requires gudang@ (dept) → finance@ (finance) → direktur@ (final) - three different people
6. Value thresholds work: Rp 50M = 3 stages ['dept','finance','final'], Rp 200k = 1 stage ['dept']
7. Rejection requires reason: Empty/whitespace reason returns 400 with 'alasan wajib diisi' message
8. Audit trail complete: Timeline shows all 3 approval steps with actor_id, actor_name, stage, timestamp for each
9. Combined inbox working: /api/procurement/inbox returns both PR and ACC-PR items with correct structure
10. Badge count accurate: /api/approval-inbox/badge pr_pending matches inbox item count
11. Ghost collection fixed: Dashboard /api/procurement/overview returns accessory_pr_total=5 (not 0)
